media_prompt: Technical illustration / visual diagram illustrating: Winning second prize in the AWS Builders Club hackathon

humanizer_audit.full_audit_report:
Walked away from the AWS Builders Club hackathon with second place.  
Last month my teammate and I signed up for the 48‑hour challenge and built a serverless app from scratch.  
We had 48 hours, a ticking clock, and a stack that kept changing.  
Picked the right services, debugged live, kept the app stable under pressure.  
When the demo ran flawless, the judges handed us second prize.  
Tight collaboration and rapid prototyping paid off.  
What’s the most daring serverless project you’ve built under a deadline? Share your story below.
